clue.text: Report of drunken sailor somewhere on the green

parts.note: Jack, or Jack Tar, is a traditional name for a sailor
high can mean intoxicated, as on drink or drugs

explanation.surface: Someone reports a tipsy sailor wandering about on a village green.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads 'Report of' as a statement: the report is 'Jack (is) high'. The green is a bowling green, where lawn bowls is played.
explanation.definitionFit: In lawn bowls a wood lying level with the small target ball is described by this term, so it names a position on the bowling green.

clue.text: Merriment of little woman meeting seaman in Liverpool, say

parts.note: Jo March is one of the sisters in the novel Little Women

indicators.note: in means the seaman's letters are placed within the word for the city

parts.note: Liverpool is an example of a city
OS is the abbreviation for ordinary seaman

explanation.surface: A small woman has a jolly time with a sailor in Liverpool.
explanation.definitionFit: Jocosity is playful humour or jesting, a near synonym of merriment.

clue.text: Act as land surveyor? It needs to be agreed

definitions.meaning: to con is to study or pore over, and a tract is a stretch of land
an agreement that both parties must accept

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to work as a land surveyor, adding that terms must be settled first.
explanation.walkthrough: The first half is a cryptic reading that splits the answer 3,5.
explanation.definitionFit: A contract is a binding deal, which only exists once the parties have consented to its terms.

clue.text: Silver — one's not first, standing by winner offering lots of fizz

indicators.note: standing by places the winner right next to what follows

parts.note: a champ, short for champion, is a winner
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

indicators.note: not first tells us to drop the opening letter of the word ones

parts.note: taken as written without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: A silver medallist who missed out on gold stands beside the winner amid sprayed sparkling wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not first' drops the O of ONES, leaving NES.
explanation.definitionFit: Champagnes are sparkling wines, and the plural answers to 'lots of' effervescent drink.

clue.text: Nonsense from 'darling' having love for any number

indicators.note: having love in place of the number begins the swap of one letter for another
for marks what love replaces: it stands in place of the number

parts.note: honey is a term of endearment like darling
N stands for an unspecified number in maths
love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses being called 'darling' as nonsense from a person who loves anyone at all.
explanation.walkthrough: Replacing N with O turns HONEY into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Hooey is informal American slang for rubbish or baloney.

clue.text: Fellow carrying Indian stick, old means for getting rid of pests

definitions.text: means for getting rid of pests

indicators.note: carrying means the man holds the stick and the old letter inside him

parts.note: a fellow is a man
a lathi is a long heavy stick, often iron-bound, used by Indian police

explanation.surface: A man wielding an Indian staff is pictured as an old-fashioned way of chasing off vermin.
explanation.definitionFit: Malathion is an organophosphate insecticide used to kill insects on crops and livestock.

clue.text: Belonging in a very quiet old city, one occupying someone else's property

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical mark for very quiet
Ur was an ancient city of Mesopotamia
a tenant lives in property owned by a landlord

explanation.surface: Someone living quietly in an ancient city as a renter is said to belong there.
explanation.definitionFit: Appurtenant is a legal adjective for something attached or pertaining to a property, so belonging to it.

clue.text: Fixed in Aegean location to the north

indicators.note: in a down entry, going to the north means reading upwards, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: Delian means of Delos, a small sacred Greek island in the Aegean

explanation.surface: Something has been settled at a spot in the Aegean, north of somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Nailed means fastened with nails, or figuratively pinned down and settled.

clue.text: Most learned maybe with coaches taking time to finish

indicators.note: taking means the time letter is picked up out of its place in the coaches
to finish says where the taken letter goes: to the very end

parts.note: stages are stagecoaches, horse-drawn coaches

explanation.surface: The cleverest scholars, perhaps, travel by coach and arrive late.
explanation.walkthrough: STAGES has its T moved to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Sage means wise, so the superlative describes those wisest or most learned.

clue.text: Like many a film showing action, oddly lacking energy

indicators.note: lacking its odd letters means only the even-placed letters of action remain

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A typical movie shows action but has little energy, oddly enough.
explanation.walkthrough: 'showing' just links the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Cine is a prefix-style word for anything relating to cinema or motion pictures, like cine film.

clue.text: Officer left drink and pipe, conking out

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for commanding officer
to lap is to drink as a cat does
to pipe is to sing in a high voice

explanation.surface: An officer who left his drink and pipe has keeled over.
explanation.definitionFit: Conking out means suddenly breaking down or passing out, which collapsing also covers.

clue.text: See about cold drink that's imbibed in Somerset

indicators.note: about means the word for see goes around the next letters

parts.note: to spy is to see
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps
rum is an alcoholic drink

explanation.surface: Someone notes that a chilled drink is a Somerset favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrumpy is rough strong cider from the West of England, Somerset being a famous cider county, so it is a thing drunk there.

clue.text: Geneticist's lad said to be a composer

parts.note: Gregor Mendel was the founder of genetics, here in possessive form

indicators.note: said to be signals that the boy's word is heard rather than spelt as written

parts.note: a lad is a son

explanation.surface: A geneticist's boy is supposedly a musician.
explanation.definitionFit: Felix Mendelssohn was a German Romantic composer of the Italian Symphony and the Wedding March.

clue.text: Number of repeated elements in narrower basis for curriculum

definitions.text: Number of repeated elements in narrower
definitions.meaning: the only repeated letter in the word narrower is R, and it occurs three times
reading, writing and arithmetic are the traditional foundations of schooling

explanation.surface: A count of recurring factors underlies a slimmer school syllabus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'narrower' is not about breadth: count its letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Reading, writing and arithmetic, the old fundamentals of primary education, are each nicknamed for their sound.

clue.text: Someone great with gadgets — tho' he may be awkward with pencil!

indicators.note: awkward letters are ones arranged clumsily, so the words are rearranged

parts.note: tho' is a shortened spelling of though, taken as written

explanation.surface: A lover of gadgets might find a plain pencil awkward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' joins the definition to the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: A technophile is a lover of technology, someone enthusiastic about and adept with new devices.

clue.text: Inventors getting shallow container with flower

parts.note: a paten is a shallow plate holding the bread at Communion
a flower is something that flows, a river, here the Tees in north-east England

explanation.surface: Inventors acquire a shallow dish with a bloom in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' means 'one that flows': the River Tees.
explanation.definitionFit: Patentees are those granted a patent, typically the inventors protecting their creations.

clue.text: Something going up in the air? Suitable feature for church, says Spooner

definitions.text: Something going up in the air?

indicators.note: Spooner signals swapping the opening sounds of the two words

parts.note: fit means suitable
a spire is the pointed tower top on many churches

explanation.surface: Something rising skyward is suggested as a fitting church feature.
explanation.walkthrough: FIT SPIRE swaps to SPIT FIRE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Spitfire was a Second World War RAF fighter plane, a thing that takes off and flies.

clue.text: Came across a figure of speech — this one?

definitions.text: Came across a figure of speech — this one?

parts.note: met means came across or encountered

indicators.note: of speech means the number is spoken, so only its sound counts

parts.note: a figure here is a digit, the number four

explanation.surface: Someone encountered a figure of speech and asks whether 'came across' is one.
explanation.walkthrough: Saying you 'came across' something, as if travelling over it, is itself figurative.
explanation.definitionFit: A metaphor is a figure of speech describing one thing in terms of another.

clue.text: Lad who's this fruit makes drink request

parts.words: Lad who's this fruit makes drink request
parts.note: read as an instruction, LAD placed round the fruit's second word gives L-APPLE-AD, which splits as LAP, a verb to drink, and PLEAD, a verb to request

explanation.surface: A boy who has some fruit asks for something to drink.
explanation.walkthrough: A reverse clue: prefix LAD to the answer and obey it as a container instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: An eating apple is a dessert variety sweet enough to eat raw, unlike a cooking apple.

clue.text: A sheep keeping quiet in retreat

indicators.note: keeping means holding the quiet letters within

parts.note: a ram is a male sheep
sh is a call for quiet

explanation.surface: A silent sheep is kept in a secluded refuge.
explanation.definitionFit: An ashram is a Hindu religious retreat or hermitage.

clue.text: What's wooden shoe?

definitions.meaning: short for sandalwood, a fragrant wood

explanation.surface: Someone asks what a clog, a wooden shoe, is.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both footwear with straps and the scented timber of the sandalwood tree.

clue.text: Gloria, say, as final vocal offering inadequate

indicators.note: inadequate means falling short, so the phrase loses its last letter

parts.note: a swan song is a final performance, from the legend that swans sing before dying

explanation.surface: Gloria's farewell song was not up to scratch.
explanation.definitionFit: Gloria Swanson was a Hollywood star of Sunset Boulevard, so she is one bearer of the surname.

clue.text: Girl with monkey spotted in meadow

indicators.note: spotted in means seen inside, so the monkey sits within the meadow

parts.note: a lea is a meadow
the titi is a small South American monkey

explanation.surface: A girl and a monkey are seen in a field.
explanation.definitionFit: Letitia is a female given name, so a girl may be called that.

clue.text: Abandoned, a female in West Country novel

parts.note: lorn means forsaken or abandoned

explanation.surface: A forsaken woman appears in a novel set in England's south-west.
explanation.definitionFit: Lorna Doone is the heroine of R.D. Blackmore's novel set on Exmoor in Somerset and Devon.

clue.text: Scientific measurement procedure? Doctor may order it

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with, so the following words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A physician may prescribe a scientific test.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' is a verb, not the physician.
explanation.definitionFit: Radiometry is the measurement of radiant energy, a scientific technique.

clue.text: See 1
Manila seen possibly as belonging to a Pacific group

indicators.note: possibly signals the letters could be arranged otherwise

explanation.surface: The Philippine capital is perhaps viewed as part of a Pacific grouping.
explanation.definitionFit: Melanesian describes the peoples and islands of Melanesia in the south-west Pacific.

clue.text: Expanse of water has run dry

parts.note: a sea is a broad expanse of water
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A body of water has run dry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has' joins the pieces; 'run' gives R, not part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Sear as an adjective, also spelt sere, means withered and dried up.
